descriptions.text: In the Malay charms and romances described by Skeat, Batara Guru is identified with Shiva and credited with restoring life. The Hikayat Sang Samba gives him life-restoring water. His identifications with the sea spirit Si Raya, the Spectre Huntsman, Kala and the Black Genie belong to particular accounts, with different families and functions.
